title: Check upstream HTTP status before parsing the response body
problem: An integration failure was reported as a JSON parse error even though the upstream endpoint returned HTTP 404 with a plain-text explanation.
cause: The wrapper deserialized every response before checking its HTTP status. Parsing the non-JSON error body failed and replaced the actionable upstream status and message with a local parser error.
fix: Reject non-2xx responses with their status and sanitized body before attempting success-body deserialization.
prevention: For integrations, preserve upstream status and body first and parse only successful responses. Test a non-JSON error response so parser failures cannot mask transport failures.
